caption: A plastic cup pulled from a stack clings to the fingers and has to be shaken off.

sa.check: A cup is pulled from the stack.
The cup clings to the fingers.
The cup stays on the hand when the fingers open, before the shake.
The order is pull, cling, shake, drop.

pc.expect: When the fingers open the cup stays against the hand with nothing gripping it, and comes away only with a shake.
pc.fail: The cup drops the instant the fingers open; or hangs a gap away from the hand; or stays on the hand through the shake to the end of the clip; or the cup clings to the far side of the room.

pc.expect: Once shaken free the cup falls downward and lands; the other cups in the stack stay where they are.
pc.fail: The freed cup floats or rises; or hangs in the air after the shake; or the stack rises toward the hand; or the cup climbs the arm.

pc.expect: The cup is thin plastic that flexes in the fingers and springs back; the stack is cups nested one in another.
pc.fail: The cup crumples like paper and stays crumpled; or stretches like rubber; or the stack moves as one solid block; or the cup melts.

pc.expect: The stack stays put as the cup is pulled; the cups do not move by themselves.
pc.fail: The stack slides across the table; or several cups come up with the one pulled and then fly apart; or cups in the stack hop; or the cup crawls across the hand.

pc.expect: One cup pulled from the stack; the cup stays whole and passes through nothing; the hand keeps its fingers.
pc.fail: The cup vanishes; or two cups appear on the hand; or the cup passes through the hand; or fingers pass through the cup.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cups' colour, the stack and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The cup changes colour; or the stack changes height between frames with no cup taken; or the table changes.

note: The hand is kept because the cling to the fingers is the physics; the person is otherwise not judged.
